entries.english:
Tuesday before Walpurgis Day. Reinhard von Uissigheim: Weyprechtzimmern, Rüsselhausen, fishing rights in the Aspach, and three estates at Büllingsbach.

Seal: Reinhard von Uissigheim.

Date: 1422
